title: 阴阳定式、五入中定阴阳、壬山度数范围

source.title: Flying Star Feng Shui
source.passage: "Even-numbered Stars follow a Yin-Yang-Yang form." "Odd-numbered Stars follow a Yang-Yin-Yin form." "To determine the polarity of number 5 star, go by the polarity of the Period number." "Facing: Ren mountain in North direction, bearing 337.6 – 352.5" "Period 8, since 2006 is the year of occupying"

review.notes: 经网页抓取工具转录（工具会做摘录），须人工对照原网页逐字复核后方可改为 reviewed。

ambiguities: 「337.6 – 352.5」表示 337.5 归亥、352.5 归壬，即区间 (起, 止]；未说明这是普遍约定还是作者习惯
